forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Import cycles make module init order load-bearing and break tree shaking. Currently 'warn': packages/data has pre-existing barrel cycles (a module imports a type from its own directory's index.ts, which re-exports that module). They are type-only and erase at compile time. Raise to 'error' once those imports point at concrete files instead of the barrel.

forbidden.name: ui-shipped-no-services
forbidden.comment: Shipped UI code depends on src/contracts, never on @smartcompanion/services. Pages take a structural facade slice so apps can pass any object satisfying it. Tests and stories are exempt: contracts.test.ts imports ServiceFacade on purpose, to prove it still satisfies the contracts.

forbidden.name: data-is-a-leaf
forbidden.comment: @smartcompanion/data sits at the bottom of the stack and must not depend on any other workspace package.

forbidden.name: services-no-ui
forbidden.comment: @smartcompanion/services is consumed by the UI, never the other way round.
